rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE CRADLING OF THE CHILD
activities: swinging of the infant in the cradle for the first time

planetary.freeform: The first 5 nakshatras from the Sun's current nakshatra are health-giving; the last 7 nakshatras bring happiness.

exclusions: nakshatras 6 through 20 from the Sun's nakshatra which bring death, weakness, and disease
rules.notes: The text divides the 27 nakshatras starting from the Sun's position into groups yielding different health outcomes for the child's first cradling.

rules.heading: THE MUHURTA FOR THE DOLAROHAN AND TAKING THE CHILD OUT OF THE HOUSE
activities: swinging the child in a cradle
taking the child out of the house

planetary.freeform: On specified lunar days (32nd, 12th, 16th, 18th, and 10th from birth) or in the 4th month from birth, or on the 12th day.

rules.notes: Dolarohan is auspicious on specific days from birth using Mridu, Laghu, and Dhruwa nakshatras during benefic weekdays.
